title: Empathic Conversations: A Multi-level Dataset of Contextualized Conversations
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The focus is on empathy, distress, and other affective phenomena in conversations grounded in news articles about negative events.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
